name: proof-jev
description: Review code changes, trace affected tests, and find bugs that passing tests miss with mutation testing.

interface.longDescription: Inspect Git diffs, review code with Jev, and challenge tests with deliberate boundary, logic, and validation faults. Reports show exact source locations, surviving patches, and test results.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my tests would catch bugs in this change.
Review my changes and investigate anything risky.
Set up Proof-Jev for this project.
